codeReview.summary: Reviewed the worker transcript skeleton, handoff, and commit 27f1b5ec across `src/control-plane/extensions/linear/commands.ts`, `src/control-plane/extensions/tickets/store.ts`, and the added regressions. The implementation matches the feature intent: autosync now defers delivery application until the local ticket sync succeeds, existing-ticket Linear syncs can return `noop` when reruns dedupe cleanly, and the tickets store now reports actual `changed`/`recorded` signals so duplicate reruns do not churn status/checkpoint state.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission currently lacks a documented repo-bound way to force a local-sync failure or a deduped rerun during `hack linear` verification, so workers cannot fully satisfy the manual VAL-LINEAR-006/007 proof path with repo-bound commands alone.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `.factory/skills/control-plane-worker/SKILL.md:30` requires repo-bound `./dist/hack linear ...` verification for Linear state behavior; `.factory/services.yaml:14-15` only documents `linear_status` and `repo_linear_smoke`; `<mission-dir>/validation-contract.md:23-29` expects forced failure and repeated-sync evidence; the handoff `skillFeedback` records the worker's justified deviation to deterministic regression tests because no safe built-in hook exists.

summary: Pass. I found the ordering/idempotency changes coherent with VAL-LINEAR-006 and VAL-LINEAR-007, and the targeted regressions cover the new pending-on-local-sync-failure and rerun-dedupe paths. The only notable gap is shared-state/process support: mission instructions demand repo-bound manual proof for failure injection, but the current skill/services surface does not document a safe way to do that.
